At its core, it represents the divine and elegant art of singing and recitation, which has a profound connection to the Koran and Sufi traditions. A Hangama is an artist that uses sound and voice to connect with the divine, inspiring reflection, peace, and spiritual growth. The name also carries the significance of beauty and sweetness in expression and in living; as in the Prophet Muhammad's words: "Allah is beautiful and He loves beauty." The use of the name Hangama can serve as a daily reminder to strive towards elegant actions, kind words, and beautiful sincerity, as well as an inspiration to seek the beauty of the Divine within oneself.
